claims.text: Azure Backup backs up encrypted Azure VMs [3]
Azure VM Backup backs up encrypted VMs and supports restoring keys and secrets to Key Vault
Supports VMs with OS/data disks encrypted with ADE
Supports VMs encrypted using BEK [11]
Supports restoring encrypted VMs when original key and secret are not available in Key Vault [8]
PMK/SSE-encrypted VMs backed up without specific user actions
Azure Backup uses SSE for such VMs
Supports VMs with disks encrypted using PMKs
Option to use customer-managed keys for encryption when backing up VMs
Backs up CMK VMs without explicit actions; vault data encrypted same as vault [14]
Keys that are part of a certificate not supported; only standalone keys

A.notes: Describes support but not the procedure: no key vault permissions, RBAC role, or enable-backup steps; [14] is only an image link and [8] does not state the unavailable-key condition.

claims.text: Have Windows/Linux VMs with ADE enabled; create a Recovery Services vault
If encryption enabled on VMs already backed up, give Azure Backup key vault access
Resiliency > + Configure protection; Azure / Azure Virtual machines / Azure Backup; select vault
Default policy daily, 30-day retention, 2-day instant snapshots; or custom
Add encrypted VMs; Key Vault read-only access message; Enable Backup
Azure Backup needs read-only access; member users automatic, guest users must grant
Access policy via Azure Backup template, remove key permissions for BEK-only; or PowerShell/CLI
RBAC key vaults: assign Key Vault Administrator to Backup Management Service app or custom role
Trigger Backup Now from Resiliency > Protected items; monitor in Jobs
ADE retirement September 2028; ADE backup blocked after

B.notes: Omits PMK/CMK no-action case, unmanaged-disk limitation, same-subscription and standalone-key limits.

claims.text: Azure Backup Server provides recovery points for VMware VMs
MABS integrates with VMware vSphere to restore VMware VM recovery points [1]
For alternate location recovery MABS uses the ESXi host
vcentervm1 is used as the vCenter server for VMware VM recovery
Reprotecting VMware VMs involves VMware properties referencing the MABS server
MABS uses vCenter custom attribute DPMServer to identify/reprotect VMs

A.notes: Vague answer that never gives the restore procedure despite citing the restore article; vSphere is not named in the cited text; no gold facts present.
